paper_title: Experimental search for invisible dark matter axions around 22 μeV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted from the paper's stated limit of 0.93 x g_KSVZ using g_KSVZ = 3.91e-16 GeV^-1 x (m_a/ueV))
notes: CAPP-12T multi-cell cavity haloscope search in a 12 T field. Null result excludes g_agamma >~ 0.93 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL over 21.86-22.00 ueV, assuming rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard boosted Maxwell-Boltzmann halo lineshape. The emitted couplings are the KSVZ-relative limit converted to absolute GeV^-1 units at the two mass endpoints; the actual limit in Fig. 5 fluctuates bin-by-bin around this average value (average sigma = 0.16, total systematic uncertainty 4.7%).
